pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: tests/e2e/conftest.py:5 Spawning the real athena serve process over real sockets in an isolated ephemeral environment verifies true startup, network handshake, and exit hygiene as required by client hosts.

techniques.evidence: tests/e2e/conftest.py:5 The e2e suite is constructed as a live-app harness spawning the actual athena serve process over real sockets to verify true startup, port binding, and exit hygiene.

tests/e2e/conftest.py:18 Every spawned daemon runs in an isolated ephemeral lane: port 0, per-instance token, dedicated ATHENA_HOME in tmp_path, and stripped credentials prevent external network leakage.
tests/e2e/conftest.py:217 The harness absorbs Windows console launcher process-tree quirks via _kill_tree (taskkill /F /T) to prevent orphaned child interpreters from leaking open ports.
tests/e2e/conftest.py:112 Tests use deterministic recorded provider interaction transcripts formatted as synthetic NDJSON rounds rather than making non-deterministic live API calls.

tests/e2e/conftest.py:97 Process assertions are verified through the public console script entry point and parsed using external readers (json and SSE stream parsers) rather than internal Python state.

tests/e2e/test_spawn_and_handshake.py:210 The test harness validates its own orphan-detection probe via a deliberate negative control that spawns a real sleeping descendant to prove the check fails when an orphan exists.
tests/e2e/test_spawn_and_handshake.py:80 Authentication gate verification dynamically enumerates every route reported by /health rather than asserting against an arbitrary scoped subset of endpoints.

tests/e2e/test_decisions.py:104 Documents that internal defensive branches (such as validator_failed in GateHook._check_grant) are unreachable by construction and avoids pinning unreachable internal branches.
tests/e2e/conftest.py:383 Lightweight per-test ephemeral homes provide full filesystem isolation without the cost of heavy infrastructure provisioning.
tests/e2e/conftest.py:3 Partitions fast in-process unit/integration daemon testing (tests/daemon/) from full out-of-process process-spawning testing (tests/e2e/) into separate suites.
tests/e2e/test_connectors_journey.py:76 Uses a far-side oracle verifying the external provider fake request log (sent entries) to confirm that actions were actually dispatched to remote hosts.

tests/e2e/conftest.py:408 The Spawn.flags helper treats configuration options (voice backend, connectors enabled, token auth) as orthogonal axes across the e2e test ladder rather than conflating them with suite rungs.
